programs.title: Kiss Kis Ko
programs.desc: A group of young Indian men calling themselves Band of Boys decide to perform publicly, to share their talents India-wide, as well as to make a career for themselves. It seems the public is only interested seeing a group of girls perform.

programs.title: Paagalpan
programs.desc: Young and attractive Roma Pinto is the only girl in the struggling Pinto family, consisting of five brothers who are all very protective of their sister. When Roma meets Sameer Malhotra they fall in love and wish to be married, but Sameer's father will not let him marry a poor girl and Roma's brothers will not let her get close to anyone.

programs.title: Ilaka (peddupettai)
programs.desc: Crime drama about Kumar, a man who rises from a slum to become a powerful figure in the underworld after witnessing his mother's murder. Driven by ambition and vengeance, he navigates betrayal and crime.
